# Tanya's Sprint Retro

Tanya: "We shipped the async decision widget. Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter. The Zephyr integration was the key unlock."

segments.exact: We shipped the async decision widget. Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter. The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

coverage_gaps.reason: YAML front matter is scaffolding carrying reviewer metadata, not a speech act.

footing_cases.author: memo author
footing_cases.unresolved: Envelope gives no composer or author statement for the document's own prose; submitter is the account holder but not stated as author.
footing_cases.when: Document title and editorial framing prose composed by the memo, not a quoted speaker.

bindings.name: memo author
bindings.why: Not a person's name; the bare phrase 'memo author' is a role placeholder with no identity to bind or mint.

bindings.name: Tanya TeamOwner
bindings.label: Tanya TeamOwner
bindings.why: Graph is empty and no existing actor matches; mint under her full name as the submitting participant.

bindings.why: Account email is the same person as submitted_by Tanya TeamOwner; emits a verdict under her name, never an email-labeled actor, and the graph is empty so it mints the same label to converge on one node.

observations.why: Standing is appealed to through a comparative achievement claim (velocity highest this quarter); no competence or relatedness language is carried strongly enough to add a second region.

evidence.quote: We shipped the async decision widget.
Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter.
The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

observations.why: Completed events narrated in simple past with named artifacts (widget, Zephyr integration) and a concrete figure (23 points); no hedges or modals, so realis throughout.

evidence.quote: We shipped the async decision widget.

observations.why: Flat unhedged factual assertions about shipped work, asserted and defensible but not framed as a settled operational decision; lower of claim/decision taken because no ratification or commitment language is performed.

evidence.quote: We shipped the async decision widget

observations.why: First-person plural 'We' frames the team as one body acting together; the velocity and Zephyr sentences carry no relational model and are not witnessed here.

payload.focus: Tanya TeamOwner sprint retro: shipped async decision widget, velocity 23 points, Zephyr integration unlock
payload.rationale: The retro's core claims (shipped widget, 23-point velocity, Zephyr as unlock) sit under KPIsSuccess, DependenciesIntegrations and Narrative_ZeroEffortCapture, so I expanded those areas and their child positions and observations. Because Tanya's 'proved the thesis' claim ties to positioning, I expanded PositioningThesis, Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning and its anti-pattern, category and pricing children, plus the decision-capture and evaporation narratives the widget implements. I also pulled the Sprint 4 webhook and 25+ pricing tier positions, which the same retro document touches. The Thematic and Documents doors returned NOT FOUND, and I did not expand the target-market position, which only brushes this retro.

positions.name: ShippedWidgetDelivery
positions.frame: What does a shipped async decision widget, with its velocity and integration story, tell us about whether decision capture works in practice?
positions.why: src-2 is a single segment of flat, unhedged past-tense claims: the async decision widget shipped, velocity was 23 points (highest this quarter), and the Zephyr integration was the key unlock. The widget is the decision-capture product, so the segment bears on Narrative_DecisionCaptureAtConsensus. Its sentences state delivery and attribute the result to an integration, but the segment makes no explicit link to capture at the moment of consensus, so the frame is read from the shipped artifact rather than from any stated thesis. No existing positions to consult, so this is a fresh mint.

placements.why: ShippedWidgetDelivery holds src-2, which reports that the async decision widget shipped, with velocity of 23 points and the Zephyr integration as the key unlock. The widget is the decision-capture product, so shipping it is delivery evidence for capturing decisions at the point of consensus. The segment does not state that link explicitly, so the support is thin, but it is grounded in the shipped artifact and the leaf's theme is the closest existing fit.
